source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Predict whether a lifting electromagnet will pick up or release iron objects when the current is switched ON or OFF.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Current ON: the electromagnet picks up the plastic button.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: ON: releases the iron. OFF: picks up the iron.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Current ON: the dull, lightly rusted iron nail is not picked up.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: After the current is switched OFF, the crane keeps holding the iron.

intelligence.enrichment: A lifting electromagnet lifts iron objects while current is ON and releases them when current is switched OFF. switch ON -> current flows through the electromagnet -> iron object is lifted; switch OFF -> current stops -> magnetic effect stops -> object is released The learner correctly applies this rule: A lifting electromagnet lifts iron objects while current is ON and releases them when current is switched OFF. Once the electromagnet has picked up clips, it should keep holding them until they are pulled off by hand.
